actions.name: Arguments
actions.description: The array of arguments passed to the action when it was triggered.

actions.name: Data
actions.description: The array of data submitted from form fields in the action's modal. It will be empty before the modal form is submitted.

actions.name: Eloquent model FQN
actions.description: The Eloquent model FQN for the current action, if one is attached.

actions.name: Eloquent record
actions.description: The Eloquent record for the current action, if one is attached.

actions.name: Selected Eloquent records
actions.description: [Actions in tables only] The selected records, filtered by individual record authorization when it is enabled. Requires accessSelectedRecords().

actions.name: Selected Eloquent records query
actions.description: [Actions in Eloquent-query-backed tables only] The query for the selected records. Requires accessSelectedRecords(). Individual record authorization has not been applied to this query.

actions.name: Mounted actions
actions.description: The array of actions that are currently mounted in the Livewire component. This is useful for accessing data from parent actions.

actions.name: Parent action
actions.description: The mounted parent action, or the containing parent action if one exists.

actions.name: Schema
actions.description: [Actions in schemas only] The schema object that this action belongs to.

actions.name: Schema component
actions.description: [Actions in schemas only] The schema component that this action belongs to.

actions.name: Schema get function
actions.description: [Actions in schemas only] A function for retrieving values from the schema data. Validation is not run on form fields.

actions.name: Schema set function
actions.description: [Actions in schemas only] A function for setting values in the schema data.

actions.name: Schema component state
actions.description: [Actions in schemas only] The current value of the schema component.

actions.name: Schema operation
actions.description: [Actions in schemas only] The current operation being performed by the schema. Usually create, edit, or view.

actions.name: Schema state
actions.description: [Actions in schemas only] The current value of the schema that this action belongs to, like the current repeater item.

actions.name: Table
actions.description: [Actions in tables only] The table object that this action belongs to.

actionGroups.name: Eloquent model FQN
actionGroups.description: The Eloquent model FQN for the current action group, if one is attached.

actionGroups.name: Eloquent record
actionGroups.description: The Eloquent record for the current action group, if one is attached.

formFields.name: Get function
formFields.description: A function for retrieving values from the current form data. Validation is not run.

formFields.name: Eloquent model FQN
formFields.description: The Eloquent model FQN for the current schema.

formFields.name: Parent repeater item index
formFields.description: The zero-based index of the nearest containing repeater item or builder block, or 0 when neither exists.

formFields.name: Raw state
formFields.description: The current value of the field, before state casts were applied. Validation is not run.

formFields.name: State
formFields.description: The current value of the field. Validation is not run.

formFields.name: Operation
formFields.description: The current operation being performed by the schema. Usually create, edit, or view.

formFields.name: Eloquent record
formFields.description: The Eloquent record for the current schema.

exportColumns.name: Exporter
exportColumns.description: The instance of the exporter class that is currently being used for exporting data.

exportColumns.name: Options
exportColumns.description: The options that were defined when the export started.

exportColumns.name: Eloquent record
exportColumns.description: The Eloquent record that is currently being exported.

importColumns.name: Data
importColumns.description: The processed data for the record that is currently being imported.

importColumns.name: Importer
importColumns.description: The instance of the importer class that is currently being used for importing data.

importColumns.name: Options
importColumns.description: The options that were defined when the import started.

importColumns.name: Original data
importColumns.description: The original data for the record that is currently being imported, before it was processed.

importColumns.name: Eloquent record
importColumns.description: The Eloquent record that is currently being imported.
